title: Random Armors
body:
Have you ever dreamed of Diorite armor? Or Ladder armor? No? Good thing because this is the right mod for you!


## Contains : 
- Slime Boots : jump high (with broken feet included)
- Very Very Dense Diorite Chestplate : Costs 864 Debrits and 4096 Diorite and is 4-5 times better than Netherite ! (Yeah I'm gonna buff this one)
- Ladder Leggings : Basically buffed autojump
- Lightning Rod Helmet : You finaly can be a lightning rod by yourself (for some reason)

_And more later !_

Note : The mod is very broken and still receiving updates (eventually)
